repFinance.itemizationNote: Donor figures cover only contributions itemized in the filings we have on file, so they understate the true number of donors.

finance.sources: This data comes directly from official public records — the California Secretary of State's CAL-ACCESS database and the U.S. Federal Election Commission (FEC).
finance.bestEffort: Those filings are authoritative; the links this site draws between committees and representatives, and its grouping of donors, are generated automatically and may be incomplete or inaccurate — they are not an allegation of wrongdoing by anyone named. Verify against the official filings before relying on or republishing this information.

fundingBasis.label: What these figures rest on
fundingBasis.unavailable: Whether this total is complete could not be determined from the data on hand — it may have been cached before this disclosure existed, or computed without the measurement. Reload the page to fetch it.
fundingBasis.undated_one: {{amount}} of the {{total}} spent{{share}} has no spending date in the filing — 1 payment. The money is counted in the total; when it was spent was not reported.
fundingBasis.undated_other: {{amount}} of the {{total}} spent{{share}} has no spending date in the filing, across {{formatted}} payments. The money is counted in the total; when it was spent was not reported.
fundingBasis.unattributed_one: {{amount}} of the {{total}} spent{{share}} names no payee in the filing — 1 payment. The money is counted in the total; who received it was not reported.
fundingBasis.unattributed_other: {{amount}} of the {{total}} spent{{share}} names no payee in the filing, across {{formatted}} payments. The money is counted in the total; who received it was not reported.
fundingBasis.doNotAdd: A single payment can be missing both its date and its payee, so these two amounts overlap and do not add together.
fundingBasis.expendituresComplete: No expenditure on file is missing its spending date or its payee.
fundingBasis.unitemized: {{amount}} of the {{total}} reported raised{{share}} was filed only as a summary figure, with no donor detail. That money is NOT included in the raised total shown above, and we hold no record of who gave it.
fundingBasis.unitemizedNoBase: {{amount}} was filed only as a summary figure, with no donor detail. That money is NOT included in the raised total shown above, and we hold no record of who gave it.
fundingBasis.contributionsComplete_one: The 1 filing reconciled here reported its contributions in itemized detail.
fundingBasis.contributionsComplete_other: All {{formatted}} filings reconciled here reported their contributions in itemized detail.
fundingBasis.unreconciled: None of these filings has been checked against its own summary totals, so whether contributions were reported without donor detail is unknown.
fundingBasis.scope: These statements describe the records on file. They are not a guarantee that the source export held no others.
fundingBasis.source: From the official bulk export published {{date}}.
fundingBasis.sourceUnknown: These figures cannot be tied to a single bulk export, so they cannot be dated to a specific snapshot of the public record.
